pages.title: Better by Beam
pages.text: Reloading connects the powerful beam to a real fuel cost.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeat a Nucleeper before its charge completes to obtain a Fissile Core. The gun uses polymer and Uranium Rods. Its beam damages along its path; siren/Hazmat do not replace safety rules.
